thread:
ben-sales: Quick sync — Hydra prospect perf POC. Customer wants a reproducible run showing ~1k sustained QPS with 5k short microbursts, 99.9p tail latency <200ms for gen-style prompts. They also want SAML + KMS/HSM answers and a ballpark committed capacity quote by EOD Thu. Who can own ops + security?

maya-eng: I can drive the load plan and heatmap. Can we get their prompt mix? short vs long tokens matters a lot.

ben-sales: @mayan please assume 60% short (<=64 tokens), 30% medium (64-256), 10% long (256-1024). They said multimodal is out for now.

omar-ops: I'll own the runner infra. Plan to use dedicated pool on our staging dedicated cluster. Need burst policy: will we allow autoscale or fixed buffer nodes?

maya-eng: Recommend fixed reserved for baseline (1k qps) + autoscale for bursts to 5k. We'll include a canary fallback to smaller model to meet latency under overload.

elain-ml: For 1k sustained qps on our 8xA100-like instance profile, batching + KV cache should handle it if we quantize to int8. Need to validate token distribution.

ashley-sec: Security checklist: SAML SSO yes (IdP metadata), KMS supported for customer-managed keys, HSM latency caveat: attestation adds ~5-15ms per key unwrap — we should call that out in the report. Also they asked about SOC2/ISO — we have docs.

ben-sales: Useful. @sam-sre can you capture the HSM unwrap numbers during the run? They asked specifically whether crypto impacts tail.

sam-sre: Yep. I'll add perf probe that logs unwrap latencies and correlate with per-request tail latency.

maya-eng: Draft load plan: ramp 0->1k over 5m, sustain 15m, then poisson spike to 5k for 2m (repeat 3x with 10m between spikes). Collect per-token latency, model CPU/GPU utilization, and KV cache hit rate. Export heatmap of latency by prompt type.

maya-eng: Example load generator snippet (vegeta-like):
```
--rate=1000 --duration=15m --targets=prompts.txt
# for spike: --rate=5000 --duration=2m --pattern=poisson
```

elaine-ml: Also include a run with prefix-caching disabled to show delta. Sometimes caching masks cold-path issues for new users.

ben-sales: Pricing ask: they want committed capacity quote (monthly) + overage token/unit price. Can finance draft a sample with current reserved pricing and burst surcharge?

omar-ops: For numbers we need sequence length assumptions. Use average token length 80 for billing estimate?

ben-sales: Use 80 avg. Provide cost for baseline 1k sustained and projected for 5k bursts.

ashley-sec: I'll attach SAML metadata template and the KMS/HSM Q&A. I'll also confirm whether customer-managed KMS requires VPC peering on Private.

sam-sre: Quick note — when we enable HSM key unwrap tracing, we need to scrub key IDs in logs (PII). We'll provide sanitized logs for the customer.

ci-bot: deploy:load-runner #1738 started by omar-ops at 1738010000

maya-eng: ETA: I can produce the heatmap + initial run artifacts by tomorrow morning if infra is ready. Need someone to approve the model variant list for canary fallback.

elaine-ml: Proposed model set: hydra-pt-4-med (baseline), hydra-pt-4-small (fallback). We'll include quantized variants in results.

ben-sales: Thanks team. Action items:
- maya-eng: create load recipes and collect heatmap (due TOM 10:00 PT)
- omar-ops: stand up dedicated pool + autoscale policy (due EOD today)
- sam-sre: HSM probe + sanitized logs (during run)
- ashley-sec: SAML/KMS doc + carve-outs for HSM impact (due EOD)
- finance (cc): draft pricing estimate using avg token=80 (due EOD Thu)

ben-sales: I'll loop the customer in once we have the run schedule. :thumbsup:

maya-eng: ack. Posting run config to the shared doc: https://redwood-internal/prod/pocs/hydra/perf-plan (will write results to the same doc).

omar-ops: starting infra prep now. ping me if you want to change instance mix.

ashley-sec: attaching SAML template in thread — (link) and KMS Q&A.

ben-sales: great, closing this sync for now. Will update with schedule.
